story.challenge: Advertising treatment specials in a way that grabs attention without losing a professional medical look.
story.solution: A high-impact poster with bold type, clinical photography and one clear call to action.
story.impact: Increased walk-in inquiries and bookings through the promotional period.

testimonial.text: The poster looks fantastic and has definitely helped bring in new clients. The design is professional and the specials are easy to read at a glance.
testimonial.author: Business Owner
